title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.21459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. Ho

translated_title: 面向高效多模态大语言模型的平衡孪生权重因子分解
translated_abstract: 权重因子分解方法旨在降低模型的延迟、内存占用，或两者兼而有之。这类方法通常将一个预训练模型分解为两个或多个因子，以更少的参数量和浮点运算次数（FLOPs）来近似原始模型权重。然而在实践中，由于用多个较小的权重矩阵替换单个大权重矩阵会引入额外开销，WF方法难以将更少的FLOPs转化为实际延迟的降低。为解决这一问题，我们提出了平衡孪生权重因子分解，该方法利用因子化模型的独特结构，在降低延迟的同时提升学习能力。具体而言，BTWF在共享基WF的设置下运行，即将两个或多个层分解为一个共享基矩阵和一个层专属的混合矩阵。如果这些共享层具有相同的输入（即互为“孪生层”），那么我们只需执行一次共享前向传播，从而减少推理时间。
tldr: 提出平衡孪生权重因子分解（BTWF），利用共享基因子分解中孪生层输入相同的特性，只需执行一次共享前向传播，从而在降低推理延迟的同时提升模型学习能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which exploits the structure of shared-basis factorized models by performing the shared forward pass only once for twin layers with identical inputs, simultaneously reducing inference latency and increasing learning capacity.
